name: yomi-reader
description: Let Claude read your Yomi Reader RSS library and the article you're reading.
long_description: Read your Yomi Reader library from Claude: stations, feeds, articles by time range, saved articles with highlights, and the article open in Yomi Reader right now. Requires the Yomi Reader app with Settings → Assistant → "Let assistants read your Yomi Reader library" turned on. Read-only unless you also turn on "Allow assistants to make changes" (mark read, star, save); you choose which stations assistants can see.
